{{Short description|American chemist and university president (1922–2009)}}
'''Henry R. Linden''' (February 21, 1922 – September 13, 2009) was an American [[chemist]] with a focus on energy research, president of the [[Institute of Gas Technology]], founding president of the [[Gas Research Institute]], and president of the [[Illinois Institute of Technology]].<ref name="NAP">[http://www.nap.edu/openbook.php?record_id=13160&page=277 National Academy of Engineering, Memorial Tributes:  Volume 15 (2011);Henry R. Linden;by Robert S Linden and Margaret M. Murphy]</ref><ref name="CHICAGO-SUN">[http://legacy.suntimes.com/obituaries/chicagosuntimes/obituary.aspx?n=henry-r-linden&pid=133745637 Chicago Sun-Times:Obituary;Henry R. Linden]</ref><ref name="CHICAGO-TRIBUNE1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20160919151816/http://articles.chicagotribune.com/keyword/illinois-institute/featured/2 Chicago Tribune:FEATURED ARTICLES ABOUT ILLINOIS INSTITUTE - PAGE 2;Henry R. Linden, 87 years, world-renowned authority in energy research and policy and an icon at Illinois Institute of Technology (IIT)]</ref><ref name="CHICAGO-TRIBUNE2">[https://www.chicagotribune.com/2009/10/05/henry-linden-1922-2009/ Chicago Tribune:Henry Linden, 1922-2009: 'Mr. Energy' at Illinois Institute of Technology;October 05, 2009;By Dan Simmons]</ref><ref name="REUTERS">{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130201062515/http://www.reuters.com/article/2009/09/28/idUS161257+28-Sep-2009+PRN20090928|title=Reuters Press Release;Henry Robert Linden: World-Renowned Energy Expert;Mon Sep 28, 2009 3:31pm EDT;IIT Mourns the Loss of Beloved Alumnus and Colleague}}</ref>
Linden was elected to the [[National Academy of Engineering]] "for contributions to methods of fuel conversion and energy utilization".<ref name="NAP"/>
He was also a fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]], and a fellow of the [[American Institute of Chemical Engineers]].<ref name="REUTERS"/>
The [[Chicago Sun-Times]] called Linden "world-renowned authority in energy research".<ref name="CHICAGO-SUN"/>
The Illinois Institute of Technology called him "an icon at Illinois Institute of Technology (IIT) and global authority in energy research".<ref name="REUTERS"/>
